ModMetaData.description:
[h1]Summary[/h1]
More mod patches for Expanded Materials - Masonry.
I did my best to make it consistent with existing mod patches written by the original author.
[h1]Covered Mods[/h1]
[list]Combat Extended Armory[/list] [list]Combat Extended Guns[/list] [list]Alpha Biomes[/list] [list]Vanilla Quests Expanded - The Generator[/list] [list]Vanilla Quests Expanded - Drone Factory[/list]
[h1]Load Order[/h1] [list]After [b]Expanded Materials - Masonry[/b] [/list] [list]Before [b]More Mod Patches for Expanded Materials - Metals[/b] (if you use that too)[/list]
[h1]Thanks[/h1] Argon - I like your mods! I'd be happy to merge these into your parent mod/repo and deprecate this. Let me know!
[h1]Links[/h1]
[url=https://github.com/eebette/More-Mod-Patches-for-Expanded-Materials-Masonry]Github[/url] - PRs welcome.
